# `pygeovision cloud`

Deploy an ONNX model as a hosted endpoint on **AWS SageMaker** or **Google Vertex AI**. (Azure ML is available from
Python only: `AzureDeployer`.) See [Cloud deployment](../../edge-cloud/cloud.md).

## When to use it

Use it to serve a trained model to other applications over HTTP.

## What you get

A summary with the endpoint name and status. Cloud endpoints **cost money while they exist**; delete them when finished.

## Things to know

* **No live cloud call was made while writing this documentation.** The packaging, handler and request building are
  tested; the real deployment needs your account, credentials, role and bucket.
* Read the cloud page before the first deploy: payload limits, IAM permissions and clean-up are covered there.

## Commands

```text
Usage: pygeovision cloud [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  Cloud deployment — AWS SageMaker, Azure ML, GCP Vertex AI.

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  deploy-aws  Deploy model to AWS SageMaker.
  deploy-gcp  Deploy model to GCP Vertex AI.
```

### `pygeovision cloud deploy-aws`

```text
Usage: pygeovision cloud deploy-aws [OPTIONS] MODEL_PATH ENDPOINT_NAME

  Deploy model to AWS SageMaker.

Options:
  --region TEXT    [default: us-east-1]
  --instance TEXT  [default: ml.g4dn.xlarge]
  --help           Show this message and exit.
```

### `pygeovision cloud deploy-gcp`

```text
Usage: pygeovision cloud deploy-gcp [OPTIONS] MODEL_PATH ENDPOINT_NAME

  Deploy model to GCP Vertex AI.

Options:
  --project TEXT  [required]
  --region TEXT
  --help          Show this message and exit.
```
